# 史蒂夫千钧一发！刷怪笼恐慌幸存者 (Spawner Panic Survivors)

![Main Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/RxQVZfVw/images/a43470d2d7044bf6b7ccc16c43b3f56b40b17ccd.png)

《史蒂夫千钧一发！刷怪笼恐慌幸存者》是一款 Roguelite 波次生存 Minecraft 模组。你将横扫汹涌而来的怪物群，利用自动攻击武器和属性强化，在限定时间内存活下来。

---

## 🎮 主要特性

* **生存波次模式**：使用“生存开始宝珠”启动游戏。随着时间推移，怪物的强度和密度不断增加，带来充满惊悚感的10波生存挑战。
* **升级与构建**：击杀敌人掉落“经验宝石”，拾取后升级。从随机提供的武器或属性强化中选择，打造属于自己的最强Build。
* **多样的自动攻击武器**：
  * 装备多种自动攻击武器并对其进行升级。武器会自动进行周期性攻击，同时支持右键触发特殊效果（主动技能）。
  * **进化武器（合成）**：在地面上近距离放置特定的武器组合，通过“地面融合仪式”伴随雷电将其融合为更高级的进化武器。在生存过程中探索出最佳的进化组合吧。
* **陷阱制作与部署系统（CP系统）**：
  * 击败敌人可获得**制作点数（CP）**，HUD界面会实时显示当前持有的CP数量。
  * 在升级界面的下方栏位中，消耗积累的CP制作7种强大的战术陷阱，以应对战局变化。
* **被动属性物品**：
  * 可选择攻击力、冷却缩减、移动速度、防御力、幸运值、攻击范围、HP自然恢复、反击伤害等多种属性强化来构建Build。
* **自定义游戏结束/胜利界面**：
  * 当角色死亡（或通关）时，会打开专属的宝箱型结果UI，可视化显示击杀数、生存时间、最终等级以及所选择的装备Build。
  * 从结果界面点击“再玩一次（重试）”按钮，即可瞬间重置物品并开始新的游戏。

## 🚀 玩法指南

1. **获取宝珠**：游戏开始时，玩家附近会出现一个箱子。从中取出**“生存开始宝珠”**。
2. **开始生存**：右键使用宝珠，系统将自动召唤专用的战斗区域（幸存者祭坛），并开启第1波攻势。
3. **击败怪物与拾取**：利用自动攻击武器和技能消灭敌人，靠近掉落的“经验宝石”将其吸入。
4. **推进波次**：每波都有时间限制。随着生存时间的延长，更强大的敌军和精英怪会逐渐包围玩家。
5. **决战时刻**：坚持到最后一波，击败最终潜伏的巨大威胁，即可取得生存胜利！

---

    *   Mod Menu (推荐用于在游戏内查看MOD信息)
*   **NeoForge版**:
    *   NeoForge (无需其他前置MOD即可运行)


English

# Spawner Panic Survivors

**Spawner Panic Survivors** is a frantic rogue-lite wave survival Minecraft mod.
Defeat incoming hordes of monsters, collect experience gems to level up,
and upgrade automatic weapons and stats to survive the Spawner Panic!

---

## 🎮 Core Features

* **Survival Wave Mode**: Right-click the **Survival Start Orb** to begin! Survive 10 waves of intense combat as enemy density and strength scale over time.
* **Level Up & Build Crafting**: Defeat enemies, gather dropped **XP Gems**, and level up. Select upgrades from a randomized pool of weapons and passive stats to define your combat build.
* **Diverse Automatic Weapons**:
  * Equip and level up various automatic weapons. Weapons strike automatically and can also be right-clicked to trigger unique active abilities.
  * **Evolved Weapons (Fusion)**: Drop a specific pair of items on the ground close to each other to perform the "Ground Fusion Ritual" (triggered by lightning) to forge a more powerful evolved weapon.
    Part of the fun is discovering which combinations yield results!
* **Trap Crafting & Deployment System (CP System)**:
  * Defeating enemies earns **Craft Points (CP)**, continuously tracked on your HUD (`CP:X`).
  * Craft tactical traps directly from the Level-Up menu (bottom slots 18–25) using accumulated CP and right-click them to deploy directly into the battlefield.
  * **7 Deployable Traps**:
* **Passive Stat Items**:
  * Customize your build with various stat upgrades: damage boost, cooldown reduction, speed, defense, luck, attack area, HP regeneration, and thorns reflection.
* **Custom Game Over & Victory UI**:
  * When you perish or win, a custom chest-style results GUI opens, displaying your stats (Kills, Survival Time, Final Level) along with your chosen build layout.
  * Click the **Play Again** button to instantly reset your items and start a fresh run.

## 🚀 How to Play

1. **Obtain the Orb**: You can grab the **Survival Start Orb** from a chest that located arround player.
2. **Start the Fight**: Right-click the orb to summon the **Survivors Altar** and begin Wave 1.
3. **Fight & Gather**: Survive and defeat mobs using your automatic skills. Move close to dropped XP Gems to pull them in.
4. **Progress Waves**: Each wave has a strict time limit. As you survive longer, stronger enemy forces and unique elite threats will begin to surround you.
5. **Final Showdown**: Survive until the final wave and defeat the ultimate threat to secure your victory!

---
